certificate.module_name: Palo Alto Networks SD-WAN Instant-On Network (ION) Devices ION 1200, ION 1200-S, ION 3200, ION 5200, and ION 9200
certificate.caveat: When installed, initialized and configured as specified in Section 11.1 of the Security Policy. The tamper evident seals and opacity shield installed as indicated in the Security Policy.
certificate.description: The Palo Alto Networks SD-WAN Instant-On Network (ION) Devices (ION 1200, ION 1200-S, ION 3200, ION 5200 and ION 9200) enable the integration of a diverse set of wide area network (WAN) connection types, improve application performance and visibility, enhance security and compliance, and reduce the overall cost and complexity of your WAN.
